rules.title: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting
rules.requirement: Bill S.2983 is a Senate bill reported favorably by the Housing Committee to prohibit algorithmic rent setting. The page gives no operative text, only the bill's title and history, and the bill has been referred to Senate Ways and Means.
rules.status_basis: Reported favorably by committee 3/12/2026 and referred to Senate Ways and Means; not enacted.
